device.description: 16-bit 500 kSPS 2-channel unipolar SAR ADC with SPI/DSP serial interface, TAG bit and daisy chain
device.note: ads8327.pdf (SLAS415E) p.3-7 electrical characteristics (+VBD 1.65-5.5 V), p.8 timing at +VBD = 1.8 V, p.10-11 pin assignments and terminal functions, p.24 start of a conversion, EOC/INT, p.25-26 power-down, p.29 digital interface, p.30 Table 4 CMR commands, p.31 Table 5 CFR, p.32 Table 6 codes, TAG, p.35 Table 7, p.37 reset

registers.name: CFR
registers.note: p.31 Table 5: configuration register; D8 default 0 (table), D1 TAG enable default 1; no address (CMR commands 1100b/1110b/1111b)

registers.name: CHSEL
registers.note: internal: the channel chosen by the CMR select-channel commands 0h/1h

commands.name: Select analog input channel 0
commands.note: p.30 Table 4: takes effect at the 4th SCLK falling edge; also wakes from auto nap

commands.name: Wake up
commands.note: p.25-26: sets CFR D3 and D2 to 1 (not D4)

commands.name: Read CFR
commands.note: p.31: the read-back is the first four result MSBs then the 12-bit CFR

commands.name: Write CFR (D0 = 0: system reset)
commands.note: p.31 Table 5 D0: 0 = system reset (registers to default)

commands.name: Write CFR
commands.note: p.30: 4-bit command plus 12 bits of CFR data, effective at the 16th SCLK falling edge

commands.name: Default mode (load CFR with default value)
commands.note: p.30: CFR loaded with its default at the 4th falling edge (SDI tied to +VBD gives this every cycle)

pages: p.3-7 (electrical characteristics: +VBD 1.65-5.5 V, digital inputs to +VBD + 0.3 V), p.8 (timing at +VA = 2.7 V, +VBD = 1.8 V: internal CCLK 10.5 MHz min, td(SCLKF-SDOVALID) 16 ns, td(CSF-SDOVALID) 13 ns, td(CSR-SDOZ) 8 ns), p.10-11 (pin drawings and terminal functions), p.24 (18-CCLK conversion, CONVST falling edge, auto trigger, EOC/INT), p.25-26 (power-down), p.29 (digital interface), p.30 (Table 4 CMR), p.31 (Table 5 CFR, reading the conversion result), p.32 (Table 6 straight binary, TAG mode), p.35 (Table 7), p.37 (reset)
notModeled: analog input and external reference: every conversion returns the 0 V code 0000h

conversion time is 18 CCLK at the 10.5 MHz minimum internal clock (+VBD = 1.8 V table, 1714.3 ns); CCLK = SCLK/2 (CFR D10 = 0), the 21-CCLK auto-trigger cycle (D9 = 0) and the minimum CONVST spacing are not timed; with auto trigger the model converts back to back
quiet zone around end of sampling and the pipelined result (FS/CS falling before the end of conversion reads the previous result): the model always outputs the constant 0 V code
SDO outputs all 1s during the first cycle after power-on or software reset (the model outputs the normal frame)
daisy-chain mode (CFR D5 = 0: EOC/INT/CDI becomes the chain data input, 16/24-SCLK pass-through); with D5 = 0 the pin is left inactive
power-down modes: deep power-down (D2), nap (D3), auto nap (D4) and their wake-up times; CFR bits are stored only, Wake up sets D3/D2
the 4-bit CMR is not readable; the CFR read-back reply starts after the 4 command bits (the 4 result MSBs before it are the frame's normal output)
SPI mode: the part samples SDI and changes SDO on SCLK falling edges and works with CPOL = 0, CPHA = 1 or CPOL = 1, CPHA = 0 (p.29); modeled as mode 2
auto channel select (CFR D11 = 1, the power-on default) alternating channel 0 and 1: the channel only changes with the select-channel commands (TAG bit outputs CHSEL.CH)
CFR reset value: Table 5 gives D8 default 0 while the text says all 1s (except D1); the table value is used
variants: ADS8327 (single channel +IN/-IN, RESERVED pin, CFR D1 reads 0) shares ads8327.pdf; own spec. ADS8329/ADS8330 (ads8330.pdf) are the 1 MSPS versions.
